$doc: Era layout spec v1 — DATA, NOT CODE (roadmap/plans/foil-main.md).
Rects are fractions of the card face, measured on 600x825 cache scans,
origin TOP-LEFT (matches image space; the shader converts to UV y-up).
artWindow = the illustration box inside the frame. holoZone semantics:
window = foil fills the art window (classic holo rares),
sheet  = foil fills everything EXCEPT the art window (reverse holo),
full   = foil covers the whole face (full-art / etched / ex rarities).
cornerRadius = physical card corner, fraction of card WIDTH (~3mm/63mm).
This file is the layout-driven coarse mask tier only; art-driven masks

wotc.label: WOTC 1999–2003 (Base–Skyridge)
wotc.notes: Gold-bevel art box below the name bar. WOTC holo rares foil the full art window background (Starlight cosmos foil). No reverse holos before Legendary Collection.

modern-swsh.label: Sword & Shield 2020–2022
modern-swsh.measuredOn: approximation — borrows modern-sv rects; re-measure when SWSH work starts
modern-swsh.notes: Frame proportions close enough to SV for the coarse tier; SWSH reverse sheet uses vertical bar texture (different pattern, same sheet zone).

modern-sv.label: Scarlet & Violet 2023– (incl. Mega Evolution 2025–)
modern-sv.notes: Silver-border frame; art box runs from below the name bar to the species strip. Holo rares foil the art window; SV reverse sheet carries Poke Ball stamp texture over the body; ex / Illustration rare / Special illustration rare / Hyper rare are full-face foil.
